summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting. Changes: rich/segment.py adds ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in the ControlCode union. rich/control.py adds the format entry emitting ESC ] 0 ; title BEL, and the Control.title classmethod. rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title after set_alt_screen, gated only on is_terminal, returning a bool, with the Google-style docstring. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one elif branch calling term.set_title(title). CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added in test_console.py, test_control.py, and test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only). Nothing was run and nothing was committed; verification was by reading only.
